# Project Governance 4.2.0

This release adds explicit decision providers and evaluation of supplied text/images, and repairs
three runtime boundaries that can interrupt ordinary development.

- JEV remains the default decision provider. An explicitly configured OpenAI Decisions adapter
  supports typed advisory answers, native usage and immutable accounting. Unsupported, refused
  and unavailable answers remain distinct. Coding models and native check authority stay fixed.
- The CLI, versioned library and packaged agent guidance share one supplied-evidence evaluator.
  Image inputs retain their original identity, bounded read and explicit disclosure. The optional
  browser pilot uses model-free fixtures; it does not install or start a grounding model by default.
- New local ownership records use a stable machine digest. Renaming the computer no longer defeats
  matching process evidence. Historical records retain their original guards; no live owner is
  rewritten or released, and no conversation attachment changes.
- Newly staged inactive payloads receive write protection. Exact integrity checks remain effective,
  and native entry receipts identify a payload mismatch without exposing private exception text.
  Protection does not repair an already changed installation or prevent its owner restoring access.
- Custom checkers retain their absolute launch path after validating the executable target. Python
  virtual environments keep their dependencies. Admission, credential filtering and cleanup remain
  with the existing native command owner.
  Existing command records stay with their recorded generation; resubmission is not a migration.
- A labelled large-file regression separates selected-file coverage from complete useful evidence.
  Losing a distant essential section or an indirect helper fails the appropriate quality measure;
  high classifier confidence cannot earn correctness credit.

Qualification uses the normal 4.x local publication path. Source checks, independent Opus 5.5
medium review and exact installed-archive proof are recorded with their original evidence. Hosted CI
is not part of this qualification. The source cohort closes with 1,315 unique passing cases,
16 optional real-browser skips, two focused replacements and both typechecks passing. Final package
proof includes protected staging, prompt/continuation, greenfield entry, six real lint-backend cases,
the 20-case evaluator constituent and published-4.1 upgrade handoff. Live Decisions compatibility,
visual accuracy, local grounding
setup, native adopter continuation, accepted development benefit and token/time savings remain
unqualified. Synthetic tests do not supply those claims.

Adoption is deliberate. Publication does not upgrade projects, move chats, alter permissions or
reconcile historical ownership. The optional evaluation and browser experiment remain explicit.
